privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: 4 Seasons Golf Tour (hereinafter "the Company") considers the protection of customers' personal information very important and complies with privacy regulations under the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection and the Privacy Guidelines established by the Ministry of Information and Communication.
privacy.s1Title: 1. Items of Personal Information Collected and Collection Method
privacy.s1Intro: The Company collects the following personal information for membership registration and consultation:
privacy.s1TourRequired: Required items: Travel itinerary, expected number of people, desired region, desired country, name, contact information, email address, tour type, type of golf course, hotel/golf course level, meal level, room level, whether to use a single room
privacy.s2Title: 2. Purpose of Collection and Use of Personal Information
privacy.s2Intro: The Company uses the collected personal information for the following purposes:
privacy.s2Item1: Performance of contracts for service provision and settlement of fees for service provision
privacy.s2Item2: Content provision, purchase and payment, financial transaction identity verification, and financial services
privacy.s2Item3: Identity verification, personal identification, prevention of fraudulent use by bad members and unauthorized use, confirmation of intent to join, age verification, complaint handling, delivery of notices in accordance with the use of membership services
privacy.s2Note: Note: When traveling on a premium basis, the single room charge may vary depending on the travel date and country. Please inquire for details.
privacy.s3Title: 3. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information
privacy.s3Intro: In principle, once the purpose of collecting and using personal information has been achieved, the information is destroyed without delay. However, in accordance with the Commercial Act and related laws such as the Act on Consumer Protection in E-commerce, the information will be retained for a certain period of time:
privacy.s3Item1: Records of consumer complaints or dispute resolution: 3 years
privacy.s3Item2: Records of collection/processing and use of credit information: 3 years
privacy.s3Item3: Records of payment and supply of goods: 5 years
privacy.s3Item4: Records of contracts or subscription cancellations: 5 years
privacy.s3Item6: If collected for temporary purposes such as surveys or events: At the end of the survey or event
privacy.s4Title: 4. Personal Information Destruction Procedures and Methods
privacy.s4Intro: In principle, the Company destroys personal information without delay after the purpose of collection and use of the information has been achieved. The destruction procedures and methods are as follows:
privacy.s4ProcedureText: The information you enter to use the service will be transferred to a separate database (or, in the case of paper, stored in a separate filing cabinet) after the purpose has been achieved. It will be stored for a specified period of time in accordance with internal policies and other relevant laws and regulations for information protection purposes before being destroyed. Personal information transferred to a separate database will not be used for any purpose other than its retention, except as required by law.
privacy.s4MethodItem1: Personal information printed on paper: Shred or incinerate
privacy.s4MethodItem2: Personal information stored in electronic file format: Deleted using a technical method that renders the records unrecoverable
privacy.s5Title: 5. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties
privacy.s5Intro: In principle, users' personal information will not be provided to external parties. However, exceptions may be made in the following cases:
privacy.s5Item1: In cases where users have given prior consent: Before collecting or providing information, we will inform you of who the business partner is, what information is needed and why, and how and until when it will be protected/managed, and obtain your consent.
privacy.s5Item2: Personal information will be provided to domestic/international airlines, cruise lines, rental companies, and hotels for boarding planes, ship boarding, car rentals, and hotel check-in.
privacy.s5Item3: In cases where there is a request from an investigative agency in accordance with the provisions of the law or in accordance with the procedures and methods stipulated by the law for investigative purposes.
privacy.s6Title: 6. Entrustment of Handling of Personal Information
privacy.s6Text: To ensure smooth business operations, if we entrust the processing of a user's personal information, we will notify the recipient (hereinafter referred to as the "trustee") and the details of the entrusted work in advance.
privacy.s7Title: 7. Rights of Users and Legal Representatives and Methods of Exercising Them
privacy.s7Item1: The Company does not allow membership registration or collect personal information from children under the age of 14.
privacy.s7Item2: Users can view or modify their registered personal information at any time and may also request withdrawal of consent (cancellation of membership).
privacy.s7Item3: To view or edit your personal information, log in and go to My Page and select "Change Personal Information." To cancel your subscription (withdraw consent), go to My Page or contact us via email. We will take action without delay after verifying your identity.
privacy.s7Item4: If you request correction of errors in your personal information, we will not use or provide the personal information until the correction is complete.
privacy.s7Item5: The Company processes personal information that has been terminated or deleted at the request of the user in accordance with the provisions of "Retention and Use Period of Personal Information Collected by the Company."
privacy.s8Title: 8. Matters Concerning the Installation/Operation and Refusal of Automatic Personal Information Collection Devices
privacy.s8Intro: The Company uses "cookies" to periodically store and retrieve user information. Cookies are very small text files that the server used to operate the website sends to your browser and are stored on your computer's hard drive.
privacy.s8PurposeText: Target marketing and personalized services provided through analysis of access frequency and visit time of members and non-members, identification of user preferences and areas of interest, tracking of user activity, and identification of participation in various events and number of visits.
privacy.s8RejectText: You can configure your web browser to accept all cookies, notify you when a cookie is set, or reject all cookies. However, if you refuse to install cookies, you may experience difficulties in receiving services.
privacy.s9Title: 9. Contact Information for the Personal Information Manager
privacy.s9Intro: You may report any privacy-related complaints arising while using the Company's services to the personal information manager or the relevant department. The Company will provide a prompt and sufficient response to users' reports.
privacy.s9OrgIntro: For other inquiries or reports regarding personal information infringements, please contact the following organizations:
privacy.s9Org3: Supreme Prosecutors' Office, High-Tech Crime Investigation Division (www.spo.go.kr / 02-3480-2000)
privacy.s9Org4: National Police Agency Cyber Terror Response Center (www.ctrc.go.kr / 02-392-0330)
privacy.s10Title: 10. Technical/Administrative Protection Measures for Personal Information
privacy.s10Intro: When handling users' personal information, the Company implements the following technical/administrative measures to ensure the security of personal information and prevent it from being lost, stolen, leaked, altered, or damaged:
privacy.s10Item1Text: Member ID passwords are encrypted, stored, and managed, and only the member knows them. Confirmation and modification of personal information can only be done by the member who knows the password.
privacy.s10Item2Text: The Company is doing its best to prevent personal information from being leaked or damaged by hacking or computer viruses. Data is regularly backed up, and the latest anti-virus programs are used. Encrypted communication (SSL) is used to ensure the safe transmission of personal information over the network.
privacy.s10Item3Heading: Minimization and training of handling staff:
privacy.s10Item3Text: The Company limits the handling of personal information to only those in charge, who are given separate passwords that are regularly updated. Regular training emphasizes compliance with the Company's privacy policy.
privacy.s10Item4Text: We hold in-house personal information protection meetings to ensure compliance with the Company's privacy policy and promptly address any issues identified.
privacy.s11Text: If there are any additions, deletions, or modifications to the current privacy policy, we will notify you through the "Notices" section of the website at least 7 days in advance. However, if there are any significant changes to user rights, such as the collection and use of personal information or provision to third parties, we will notify you at least 30 days in advance.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.reservationsDeposit: When making a tour reservation, you must pay a deposit of 40% of the total tour price.
terms.reservationsItem1: If the minimum number of participants (2-4 people) is not met, the tour will be canceled. The exact departure date will be confirmed approximately 2-7 days in advance. Our travel agency will contact you first to confirm the departure date. All reservations must be confirmed by the manager.
terms.reservationsNote: Note: Same-day tours cannot be booked on the same day. Reservations for the day before the tour can only be made by phone (not online). Reservations must be made by 6:00 PM closing time for each branch.
terms.vehicleHeading: The vehicle may change depending on the number of passengers:
terms.reservationsItem3: Travel expenses must be paid by credit card or cash. Personal checks must be paid at least five days prior to departure.
terms.reservationsItem4: The hotel listed on the schedule may be changed to a hotel of the same class depending on local circumstances.
terms.reservationsItem5: The entire schedule and optional tours listed on the schedule may be adjusted depending on local conditions, weather on the day, and the guide's discretion.
terms.reservationsItem6: The United States has a culture of tipping. The basic per-person guide and driver service fee is $20 per day, and the basic tip for hotel/restaurant tips and other courtesy tips is $2.
terms.reservationsItem7: Please make sure to check the documents (passport, ID, etc.) that you must bring with you when entering or exiting Canada and other border crossing areas before departure.
terms.singleRoomItem1: The product you have reserved is based on 2 people per room, regardless of adult or child. If 3 or 4 people use a room, a discount of $20 per night will be applied to the third and fourth guests. (Up to 4 people per room)
terms.singleRoomItem2: If you are staying alone in a room, a single room charge of $80 per night will be applied. (This may change due to hotel price fluctuations.)
terms.singleRoomItem3: If you make a reservation for 2 adults/children and use 1 room, the child rate does not apply.
terms.singleRoomNote: Note: When traveling on a premium basis, the single room charge may vary depending on the travel date and country. Please inquire for details.
terms.passportItem1: You must carry your passport with you when you depart for your trip, and your passport must be valid for at least 6 months.
terms.passportItem2: The country you wish to travel to may require a visa. When traveling to a country that requires a visa, please obtain a visa through the proper procedures.
terms.generalItem1: The above schedule may be subject to change depending on weather and traffic conditions.
terms.generalItem2: Please refrain from deviating from group activities. Neither the headquarters nor the guides are responsible for any accidents resulting from individual deviations. In unavoidable circumstances, please consult with your guide and follow his or her instructions.
terms.generalItem3: Toothpaste, toothbrushes, and slippers are not provided at hotels in the United States. Just like personal medications, you must prepare these yourself.
terms.generalItem4: Most American buses don't have curtains or seat belts. You can't walk around on the bus while it's in motion. Bringing food, drinking, or smoking is also prohibited. Water (in bottles or cups with lids) is permitted.
terms.generalItem5: When temperatures exceed 85°F (30°C) in the summer, it can be difficult to initially expect comfortable conditions upon boarding the bus. All diesel vehicles are subject to strict regulations, and idling for more than three minutes carries a high penalty, with an initial fine starting at $800.
terms.generalItem6: Most hotels have swimming pools, so it is recommended to bring a swimsuit.
terms.generalItem7: Please take extra care of your personal belongings in airport waiting areas or hotel lobbies.
terms.generalItem8: Travel agencies share services with multiple companies and connect travelers with services such as hotel accommodations, transportation, and sightseeing activities. All services operate under contractual terms.
terms.generalNote: The travel agency and its employees, agents, representatives and appointed persons are not responsible for any injury, loss, damage, accident or any other cause whatsoever, including negligence of duty, defects, fault of other companies or wrongful acts of others. Individuals planning a trip can purchase travel insurance, which will cover expenses, loss, and personal losses related to the trip.
terms.cancellationIntro: Travelers may cancel their own trips before departure. Cancellation fees are as follows:
terms.hqDepositNote: When making a tour reservation, you must pay a deposit of 40% of the total tour price.
terms.hqSameDayTitle: Same-Day Tours & Tours 1 Night or More:
terms.hqSameDayItem1: 50% cancellation fee - up to 7 days prior to departure
terms.hqSameDayItem2: 60% cancellation fee - up to 5 days prior to departure
terms.hqSameDayItem3: 80% cancellation fee - 2-4 days prior to departure
terms.hqSameDayItem4: 100% cancellation fee - 1 day prior to departure
terms.hqSameDayItem5: No refund for cancellation on the day of departure (including no-show)
terms.laTitle: LA Branch Regulations - Western US Tour
terms.laItem1: 20% cancellation fee - up to one week prior to departure
terms.laItem2: 50% cancellation fee - up to 3 days prior to departure
terms.laItem3: 80% cancellation fee - 1 day prior to departure
terms.laItem4: No refund for cancellation on the day of departure
terms.cancellationNote1: The company is not responsible for any injuries, illnesses, deaths, loss, or cancellations/changes to schedules due to personal negligence, pre-existing conditions, or natural disasters.
terms.cancellationNote2: Western US and other tours: Full payment is required up to 2 weeks prior to departure.
terms.cancellationNote3: For reservations made the day before: Full amount must be paid. No refunds will be given in case of cancellation.
terms.cancellationNote4: Cancellation due to insufficient participants: Notification will be given at least 2 days prior, and full travel expenses and deposit will be refunded.
terms.cancellationNote5: If refund is made by company check for credit card payment, a 4% credit card fee will be added.
terms.cancellationNote6: If you refund a credit card payment after the payment date (after 12:00 AM Eastern Time), an 8% credit card fee will be charged. No fee on the day of payment (US time).
terms.roomItem1: Hotels in the Americas have two double-sized beds as standard, and extra beds cannot be added in accordance with fire safety laws.
terms.roomItem2: If the hotel listed on the itinerary cannot be reserved due to hotel circumstances, the hotel may be replaced with a hotel of the same class.
terms.roomItem3: Occasionally, if the hotel room is not available, a king bed and an extra bed may be provided.
terms.roomItem4: The hotel does not provide disposable items. Please bring your own slippers and toiletries.
